sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The aggregate entry groups the 4 existing independently mapped draft configurations for this venue. These configurations were previously registered under other venue entries; their exact source recipes and parent snapshot hashes are preserved. Shared edges count once and separate paths remain separate. This is a configuration network, not one lap, and does not claim current operator certification. The independent unique branch distance is 4464.2 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
